experiments.name: dependent chain
experiments.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 200 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 1065353216; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r5, -1; li.d $r6, 0' --asm 'xvfsqrt.s $xr0, $xr0; xvpickve2gr.w $r7, $xr0, 0; and $r7, $r7, $r5; or $r7, $r7, $r6; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r7'

latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency. Chain: tested op, then xvpickve2gr.w+and+or+xvreplgr2vr.w to restore the input pattern; the 9-cycle closure is subtracted (calibrated with vadd.b/xvadd.b). Swept 26 operand values including 0, powers of two, max, minnorm, maxsub, minsub, Inf and NaN: latency 11-41 cycles, CPI 6-21. The stored experiment uses 1.0. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.
